description: List the personas (the kind of traveller an itinerary is written for, e.g. foodie or collector) with their slug and audience: party_shapes (solo, couple, friends, family, multigen), children (boolean) and pace (relaxed, steady, brisk). Persona slugs are used with city slugs to name an itinerary. Paged.

lang.description: Optional BCP 47 tag; name, tagline and description in that language when translated.

status.description: Status filter (default published). Use all for every row.

name: list_personas
title: List traveller types
